$comment: dal-level spec v1.0. GENERATED from vision/app/spec/blocks.py by scripts/gen_contracts.py; do not edit.
title: blocks

ArtVariant.description:
One finished drawing of an object by Claude: an SVG whose viewBox is `0 0 w h`, fitted to the object's drawing
box (w, h = drawing.w, drawing.h), so it lines up with the physics shape made from the maker's strokes.
ArtVariant.title: ArtVariant

BFlipbook.description: Changes through its drawn frames over time (seed, sprout, flower). The frame art is the library type's frames.
BFlipbook.title: BFlipbook

BNpc.description: A character that talks: touching it shows its lines one by one in a speech bubble.
BNpc.title: BNpc

BPhysics.description: A loose object that falls, slides, stacks and can be pushed. Boxes stay upright; balls roll.
BPhysics.title: BPhysics

BPickup.description: Something to collect. `item` names it for rules ("star"); `effect` is a ready-made rule fired on collect.
BPickup.title: BPickup

BPortal.description:
Touching a portal moves the player to its partner: the other portal with the same `pair` label in the level
(a lone portal does nothing).
BPortal.title: BPortal

BScripted.description: Runs the library type's script (a developer pack, app/spec/script.py).
BScripted.title: BScripted

BZone.description:
An area with an effect while the player is inside: wind and conveyor push toward `dir`, water slows and lets
you swim up, ice is slippery, low_gravity floats, slow halves speed. `strength` scales the effect.
BZone.title: BZone

BlockCard.description: A block as listed: the newest version plus usage counted by the server.
BlockCard.title: BlockCard

BlockRef.description: v4: points at one version of a public block (app/spec/blocks.py).
BlockRef.title: BlockRef

Condition.description: `subject` is "self", "game", "other" (the object an event involved) or an object id.
Condition.title: Condition

DoPush.description: v5: give a physics body a push (cells/s added to its velocity).
DoPush.title: DoPush

DoSay.description: A speech bubble over the player (or over `target`) for `seconds`.
DoSay.title: DoSay

DoSetFrame.description: v5: jump a flipbook entity to frame `frame`.
DoSetFrame.title: DoSetFrame

DoTeleport.description: Move the player to a cell (to) or onto an entity (target). Exactly one is set.
DoTeleport.title: DoTeleport

DoToggle.description: Show or hide an entity: a hidden entity is not drawn, not solid and does nothing.
DoToggle.title: DoToggle

EnemyParams.description: Archetype parameters (§5.7); every field optional, defaults live in core/params.ts.
EnemyParams.title: EnemyParams

ObjectArt.description:
An object's look. `use` = which one plays: the maker's own strokes (cleaned up in the game view) or the chosen
AI variant. Variants are kept so the maker can switch back and forth.
ObjectArt.title: ObjectArt

OpDo.description: Run one rule action (say, sound, add_counter, toggle, win…); `say` without a target speaks from this object.
OpDo.title: OpDo

OpFollow.description: Move toward the player at `speed` (along x only, or freely in x and y).
OpFollow.title: OpFollow

OpHazard.description: Touching it hurts the player (on) or not (off).
OpHazard.title: OpHazard

OpHide.description: Hidden objects are not drawn and do nothing (their script keeps running).
OpHide.title: OpHide

OpJump.description: Jump (only when standing on something, if `gravity` is on).
OpJump.title: OpJump

OpMove.description: Set the object's velocity (cells/s; +y is down).
OpMove.title: OpMove

OpPatrol.description: Walk back and forth `range` cells around where the state started.
OpPatrol.title: OpPatrol

OpSolid.description: The player can stand on it (on) or passes through it (off).
OpSolid.title: OpSolid

Rig.description: Rig extracted from a creature drawing (§7.6). Parts are stroke ids.
Rig.title: Rig

RuleIf.description: v5: a condition on a counter (counters double as the inventory: "keys", "red gems").
RuleIf.title: RuleIf

Stroke.description: One pen stroke, in object-local pixels with (0, 0) at the object's centre.
Stroke.title: Stroke

TerrainSkin.description:
How a ground line (physics shape "line") looks in the game view: solid land filled from the line down to the
world's bottom, a surface band along the line, an optional tiled texture inside, and decorations along the top.
TerrainSkin.title: TerrainSkin

WhenChoice.description: v5: the player picks choice `index` (0-based) in a talking character's choices.
WhenChoice.title: WhenChoice

WhenCollect.description:
A coin, big coin, key or pickup is collected: one entity (target), any pickup with this item name, or any
coin (item "coin"). Exactly one of target or item is set.
WhenCollect.title: WhenCollect

WhenFrame.description: v5: a flipbook entity reaches frame `frame` (0-based).
WhenFrame.title: WhenFrame

WhenKey.description: Fires on the frame the key goes down (an edge, never while held).
WhenKey.title: WhenKey

WhenTimer.description: After `seconds` from the level start (the first input), or every `seconds` when `every`.
WhenTimer.title: WhenTimer

WhenTouch.description: Fires on the frame the player starts touching the entity (edge).
WhenTouch.title: WhenTouch

WhenZone.description: The player's feet enter the rectangle (cells, half-open [x0, y0, x1, y1]).
WhenZone.title: WhenZone
